name: meeting-notes
description: Meeting notes on this computer (Linux, PipeWire): notice a meeting app on the microphone, record your microphone and the computer's sound as two tracks after you agree, and transcribe them locally with whisper.cpp (downloaded on first use); triggers for detected and recorded meetings

nodes.title: Who uses the microphone
nodes.description: Lists the programs using the microphone that could be a meeting (Zoom, Teams, a browser…), and the recording in progress

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Wait for a meeting
nodes.description: Watches the microphone until a meeting app has used it for confirm_seconds, then returns one event (the meeting_detected trigger); each meeting is reported once, never while recording; returns no event after timeout_seconds (at most 280)

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous call; without it the watch starts now

confirm_seconds.description: How long a meeting app must use the microphone

release_seconds.description: How long the microphone must be free before the next meeting is reported

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Start recording a meeting
nodes.description: Records the microphone (You) and the computer's sound (Others) as two tracks until stop_recording, or until no meeting app has used the microphone for MEETING_NOTES_AUTO_STOP_SECONDS; runs on its own, so the step returns at once

meeting_app.description: The program of the meeting, e.g. from the meeting_detected trigger

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Recording status
nodes.description: The meeting being recorded, if any

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Stop recording
nodes.description: Stops the recording (the one in progress, or meeting_id) and waits until its files are complete

meeting_id.description: Meeting id from start_recording or the meeting_recorded trigger

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Wait for a recorded meeting
nodes.description: Returns the meetings whose recording ended since the cursor (the meeting_recorded trigger), waiting up to timeout_seconds (at most 280) for one

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous call; without it, only meetings ending from now on count

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Transcribe a meeting
nodes.description: Transcribes a recorded meeting on this computer with whisper.cpp (downloaded the first time, about 150 MB): the microphone as "You", the computer's sound as "Others", silence skipped; deletes the audio afterwards unless keep_audio. A meeting already transcribed returns its transcript

meeting_id.description: Meeting id from start_recording or the meeting_recorded trigger

language.description: auto, or a language code such as en or id (default MEETING_NOTES_LANGUAGE, else auto)

keep_audio.description: Keep the recorded audio after the transcript is made

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

tools.name: detect
tools.description: Lists the programs using the microphone that could be a meeting (Zoom, Teams, a browser…), and the recording in progress

tools.name: recording_status
tools.description: The meeting being recorded, if any

triggers.title: When a meeting is detected
triggers.description: A meeting app (Zoom, Teams, Meet in a browser…) uses the microphone. Ask before recording: a human-input step, then start_recording.

outputs.name: meeting_app
outputs.description: The program, e.g. Zoom or Google Chrome

outputs.name: consent_reminder
outputs.description: One line to show when asking

triggers.title: When a meeting is recorded
triggers.description: A recording stopped (by stop_recording or because the meeting ended). Transcribe it, then summarize and send.
